title: World Championship Decks 2003: card flavor text

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: A cephalid empress who values hindsight.

entities.name: Teroh
entities.description: An aven leader who dreams of his enemies' doom.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A Cabal being who dismisses sacrifices.

entities.name: Visara the Dreadful
entities.description: A being whose eyes are her strongest feature.

entities.name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
entities.description: A wizard who journeyed where none have been before.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact that offers what you want, not what you need; the land drank its power.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: The order blamed by barbarians for blaming the Cabal.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land with a glittering horizon.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge from which goblins poured.

events.summary: Goblins pour from the Skirk Ridge like lava.
events.quote: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

events.summary: The land drinks power from the Mirari.
events.quote: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

events.summary: Phage orders a sacrificed necromancer's body tossed aside.
events.quote: Now toss his body over there with the others.
